name: Payroll register to ledger reconciliation
summary: At period end, the accountant or controller gets one worksheet proving the payroll register against the ledger: gross pay, employer taxes, deductions and net pay. Every difference is sorted as timing, miscoding or unexplained, with a question for each. Nothing is posted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method for agreeing a payroll register to the general ledger at period end, written from how the work is done in companies under 200 people. No third-party text.
